capabilities: Display root and nested folders as scroll volumes with vertical title slips
Expand note pages on hover or focus to show vertically-set summaries
Search note titles, summaries and paths with auto-expanding matches
Toggle visibility of individual root and subdirectories in settings
Open notes in new tabs or split panes from the home view
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian community plugin directory; manual installation via GitHub Release ZIP. README notes mobile (iOS/Android) is unverified and the plugin is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Runs fully locally, no AI or external services.
motivation: The author was inspired by the ancient Chinese 'dragon scale' book binding (longlin zhuang), treating each directory as a scroll and each note as a page.
problem: Obsidian's default file browsing is a flat sidebar list with no visual way to page through folders and preview note content in one place.

relations.evidence: 安装「宋韵·清和」主题时直接继承其颜色和纸纹

summary: Home-page plugin that renders vault folders as traditional Chinese scrolls with vertical title strips and expandable note summaries.
